common_method: C local recovery + paired cosine fusion margin0.1

base.scope: All future CLUE 10-5 incremental runs use this step0 unless user explicitly changes it; other task splits require matching future-background0 step0.

kd.channels: old foreground only, excluding background and new channels
kd.distance: sum of Bernoulli KL across old foreground channels, times T squared
kd.normalization: same valid nonignore pixel denominator for both variants (rank-local, same as baseline SEG)
kd.evidence: old teacher foreground, sigmoid winning logit >=0.75 and classifier cosine>=0; no refined new candidate OR cosine conflict resolved to old by margin0.1; exclude C recovered and new-strong/ambiguous conflict pixels

channel_selection.counter: Ordinary old-FG KD everywhere, remove only teacher-positive old-class channels (rawsigmoid>0.5) on existing supported-new pixels; retain negative and unresolved soft knowledge.
channel_selection.relations: Keep highconfidence old-class absence (rawsigmoid<=0.25) anywhere, and the teacher-winning old-class positive (>=0.75) only on existing protected-old pixels; normalize total channel-weight budget to ordinaryKD when nonempty.

kd.relations_weight_normalization: sum channelweights equals eligiblepixels*old_count if nonempty; not equal measuredKL/gradientnorm

checkpoint_policy: only final checkpoint of each stage; retain until later stages and all analysis complete; never delete canonical step0; archive metrics/hashes before deleting inferior run weights
analysis: stage1 and stage2 old/new/initial/incremental per-class IoU
all-active-batch KD coverage, protected/new/unresolved and conflict counts
paired final predictions and old-to-new/new-to-old errors
paired image bootstrap 95% CI (evaluation sampling only, not seed variance)
channelcoverage, positive/negative retained/dropped quality, channel-weight budget and actualKLstrength
limitations: A800 no-KD result is a historical context reference; different GPU/runtime cannot prove net KD gain
evaluation labels never enter incremental training or mask selection
Channel-weight-budget normalization does not ensure equal observedKL or gradient mass.
Historicalplain/evidence eachoneseed; freshcontrols/replication may be needed to substantiate gain.

resource_policy.latest_user_instruction: Use four idle GPUs, two strategies concurrently, two GPUs per task

method_variants.counter: Ordinary old-FG KD everywhere, remove only teacher-positive old-class channels (rawsigmoid>0.5) on existing supported-new pixels; retain negative and unresolved soft knowledge.
method_variants.relations: Keep highconfidence old-class absence (rawsigmoid<=0.25) anywhere, and the teacher-winning old-class positive (>=0.75) only on existing protected-old pixels; normalize total channel-weight budget to ordinaryKD when nonempty.

fresh_control: Existing kd1 ordinaryKD full chains on same runtime/world2/spg4/global8; physical GPU pairs differ. No fresh plain run in current two-task allocation.
